reviews.text: Never disappoints coming here! Always have a great experience coming here with both my dogs.

We had such a great experience at this veterinary clinic! Everyone was so kind, caring, and professional, and they made us feel very comfortable from the moment we arrived. Snoopy absolutely loved it there, which says a lot! We’re so happy with the care he received and will definitely be coming back.

Dr. Youk, Receptionist Lydia, and Care Team Members Danely & Kuro were absolutely awesome with my fur baby.  Chase is an 11 year old chihuahua,  and if you know anything about this breed,  you know they're small but mighty. Im truly grateful for the kind attention,  their patience and their mindful efforts in taking the time to make sure my family and I understood what was going on with Chase. Thank you team. Its never easy to see your fur baby not feeling well,  but you all we're great with us and especially with him.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I cannot say enough wonderful things about my experience here. From the moment I checked in, everyone was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful. The entire process was easy and comfortable, and I genuinely felt like Jax was in great hands.

Dr. Henderson was absolutely amazing—one of the best veterinarians I’ve seen in a long time. She listened to my concerns, respected exactly what I wanted for Jax, and never pressured me into unnecessary testing or procedures. She focused on what he actually needed, made sure he was comfortable, and took wonderful care of him. That meant so much to me, especially with an older dog.

Danely at reception was fantastic, and Kim, Kuro, and Jason were equally wonderful. Everyone was sweet, compassionate, professional, and genuinely caring toward Jax. You can tell this is a team that truly loves animals and cares about the people who bring them in.

I walked out feeling completely confident that Jax received exactly the care he needed—nothing unnecessary, no pressure, just thoughtful and compassionate veterinary care. I’m so happy I found them and would absolutely recommend this team to anyone looking for a veterinarian. ❤️🐾
Great communication and attentiveness!

I have taken my pets to many vets but none have made me feel more at home than Dr. Henderson and her staff. They are all so personable and kind and treat your pets as if they were their own. They don't try to price gouge you and instead care about giving your pets exactly what they need and nothing more. I love them!

My cockerspaniel was so itchy and overdue for his cytopoint and he was able to go in at the last minute. The staff was super friendly and helpful with my pooch. It was such an easy appointment from start to finish,  and getting his prescription was fast as well. I definitely look forward to going back for our next appointment.

I’ve had such a great experience with Dr. Henderson and the entire team! Everyone is always so kind, friendly, and helpful, and I’m so glad I found this practice.

I brought my cat, Winter, in for her annual checkup recently, and Dr. Henderson was incredibly thorough and took the time to walk me through everything, including the next steps for a professional dental cleaning. She also gave me a recommendation for where to take Winter for the dental procedure, which I really appreciated.

I always leave feeling like Winter is in great hands and that all of my questions have been answered. Thank you, Dr. Henderson and team, for always taking such great care of her!

I was beyond impressed with my experience. Alexis was such a warm greeting and made my dog so comfortable from the moment we stepped in! Kuro, Danely and Lydia were all very thorough in listening to details about my dog Jax. And Dr Woods gave so many helpful tips and spent his time till all my questions were answered. I did not feel rushed once and felt very comfortable and will certainly be bringing Jax back there!

They took care of pumpkin on her first vet experience, she was the calmest I seen and the techs did amazing with her! Answered every question, concern, and made sure they paid attention to my cats body language. Really happy with the first time experience
Love this place they are wonderful!

My cat Sugar is 15 years old and has a lot of health complications. She has heart issues, thyroid problems, and breathing attacks that come on suddenly. I haven’t given a Vetco update in a while, so I wanted to thank Dr. Henderson and her team at Vetco on Clybourn.

I left my previous vet after many years because they started focusing more on money than on care. Meeting Dr. Henderson was a blessing. She treats every patient like family. Whenever Sugar has an attack, they find a way to squeeze her in right away. This helps us avoid expensive emergency room visits and keeps the costs down for all the treatments and medications she needs.

I honestly thought we would have to put Sugar down last year, but she has made it almost another year with their care. We do everything we can to make her comfortable and give her the best quality of life, and Dr. Henderson’s compassion and skill have made a huge difference.

One thing I like about Vetco is that I can take care of everything in one trip. After her appointment, I stock up on the pet products we need. The Vetco membership plan has been a big money saver, especially for a senior cat who has to go to the vet often. I do not have pet insurance, and I am not sure it would even cover all of her illnesses, so the membership plan is worth it.

If you are a pet parent in Chicago looking for a vet who truly cares, Dr. Henderson and her team at Vetco are the ones to see.
Great vet! Took my Cat there and they were so nice and welcoming!!
Fast and good service, very professional
Quality services. Dr. Henderson and Danley always take great care of  my dog. Been bringing him here for 2 1/2 years since his very first appointment and will continue to.

Today was my 3rd visit with my cat.Dr.Henderson was very nice and understanding but one of his care team members was very rude. The prices are kinda high and when I said something about it her attitude was Shitty. But for the most part it’s been a pleasant experience each time I went there.
We always feel welcomed and taken care of at Vetco Clybourn. Dr Henderson is kind, patient and very knowledgeable. All the vet techs are always communicative and helpful as well.

Dr Henderson is the best. My nearly 10 year old American Bulldog has seen her since she was 8 weeks old and is one of the only people she gets super animated and excited to see! Dr H is so patient and accommodating of our stubborn and dramatic girl. Jason is a very accommodating vet tech that always follows up with our questions and needs
All of the Team were Welcoming, Professional, and Focused on Keeping Both Bella and Us at Ease….Bella Really Loved the Liver Treats!!   🌞🐶🌞 …
Amazing team!! Bao didn’t even notice that she was getting shots! Everyone was very informative and helpful!

Dr. Henderson was amazing!! I took my puppy Haze for his very first vet visit and from the beginning the receptionist Alexis was welcoming then the care team Lydia answered all my questions and was so sweet and made Haze feel so comfortable! Dr was able to same day give all his first vaccines, detect his little ear infection and send us home with meds! Couldn’t be happier with my first visit! Haze left smiling!
5 STAR ALL THE WAY AROUND, from Front desk, to Kuro.to Dr Henderson!   The customer service was on point, place clean, made you feel comfortable with your pet!  This place is a win win!!!

Everyone was so kind and patient with my pet. They quoted me for prices before they began the exam so I made sure I knew what I was paying for. The doctor also explained his exam and medications very well. An amazing first patient visit, would recommend especially for skittish pets!

Love this Petco location! They have done a great job, taking care of my cats whether it be vaccinations, wellness checks, or meds for traveling. The staff and doctors are incredibly kind and patient and you can tell they really love animals special shout out to Dr. Henderson, Alexis, Kuro, Lydia, and Laura.

Dr Jen  and team (Danely, Kuro, Jason, Alexis) are smart and kind caregivers of my 2 pups. It's is wonderful to work with a team I trust. Excellent care and service! Highly  recommend! Also recommend Vital Care benefits!
Excellent care once again from Dr Henderson and her team.
Lydia, our tech, is awesome! So patient and knowledgeable. Our vet was great too. She was wonderful with our dog during in health exam.

This Vetco Total Care hospital is nothing but a corporate money grab. They do not care about your pet; they only care about their bottom line. Do not let the friendly hospital staff fool you—the corporate system behind them is designed to trap you in high-pressure upsells and rigid, profit-driven policies.My experience with their heartworm refill policy proved exactly how greedy this corporate setup is. They admitted my current heartworm test was completely valid. Yet, they still blocked my standard 3-month refill because a new test would technically be due in 10 days. They refused the refill solely to force me back through the door for a mandatory $70 recheck fee on top of the $90 exam fee I already paid. When I asked if this roadblock was a legal requirement, they admitted it was just 'company policy.' It is a rigged system to ensure you leave the hospital with a $700 bill for simple issues like an ear infection or a fecal test.To be absolutely clear: the staff at the standalone Petco vaccination clinics are wonderful, affordable, and straightforward. This review is not about them. This is about the full-service hospital utilizing urgent, high-pressure 'must-do' tactics to exploit pet owners' love for their animals. Their escalating corporate costs make vital care completely inaccessible. Avoid this hospital if you want a vet care system that actually prioritizes medicine over corporate profit

If you're looking for a new vet or looking to establish care with a vet, this is absolutely the location and place to go! Dr. Henderson, Lydia, Laura, Danley, and the entire team at the Clybourn Vetco are absolutely phenomenal. I recently switched here from BondVet, and the experience has been a complete 180. I hate feeling like just another client or number to a business, but this team completely ruins that stereotype. They are so welcoming and personable that they actually know and remember my dogs by name.

Every single visit goes perfectly. Service is quick, thorough, and incredibly affordable. What I appreciate most is their absolute honesty—they will straight-up tell you which products are actually worth it versus what is a waste of money, and they always suggest practical alternatives they’ve used and trust. They’re also amazing at helping you save money, proactively applying any discounts or sales they have running on medications or wellness products.

To show you how much they genuinely care: my dog recently had an ER visit, and the very next day, this team texted me just to check in on him. I never feel like a bother or like I’m asking for too much here. Anytime I have a question, I get honest, real feedback. I recommend this location to everyone. I will never change vets unless Dr. Henderson leaves the practice!

Dr. Henderson's warmth is what I was missing from my former Vet's office. She listened, was compassionate, and I felt like she cared. The receptionist and nurse were equally as kind. Very grateful for the first time visit coupon. Thank you!

I always come back to this Vetco because everyone here is always so attentive and helpful. I've been to different vet clinics over the years and this one is genuinely the best. Dr. Henderson, Laura at the front desk, and Kuro were all great today!  Never had a single problem with here, and I'll definitely keep bringing my cats here for their care 💕
They were very patient and took great care of my German Shepard.

Very friendly staff from beginning to end.  They listen to your concerns and answer your questions.  I’m always on a budget and they work with me and give me informative information and I’m always able to get the best treatment my dog deserves.  I highly recommend going to Vetco.
Dr gartlan was phenomenal with my Pomeranian and the receptionist Lydia was awesome will definitely take my dog back

There is no compassion for pets here!  The customer service Lydia provided was terrible! She should not be working reception with customers! Laura was proactive and helped with resolution. It’s difficult to get in contact with someone answering the phone! I will never take my dogs here again!

I love VETCO on Clybourn! My English Bulldog loves the staff and everyone is so attentive, helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable. Typically we see Dr. Henderson who is great, but this visit we saw Dr. Kim, Danley, and Jason who created a great care plan for my dogs’ chronic allergies. We also love being greeted and taken care of by the receptionist Lydia who always has a smile on her face and is super friendly. Thanks for taking care my dog, we enjoy
Excellent care with my 3 year old yellow lab Ellie!

Dr Henderson and Eboni were super sweet and through!

I came to Vetco cause my previous vet said my babies sneezing was nothing to worry about  and charged us $160 for the visit

Vetco was $90 for the vet visit and Dr Henderson actually asked lots of questions and looked into my kitties ears. She suggested a test to see what kind of bacteria was in my kitties ears ($50) and the test results were done in 15-20 mins!

We got medication  ($40) and we are more than happy to come back to see Dr. Henderson as a follow up :)

Picture is of my baby being super calm and happy during his vet (he found the pillow in the room and decided it was his new spot)

TL;DR They took my puppy out of sight and did things to her that I didn’t agree to initially. They made a decision for me in order to charge me for the full visit instead of rescheduling.

I came here for the puppy packages. They took my puppy in the back and proceeded to give her a round of vaccines from a package I did not agree to. They said it was because she was too young (by a week, even though they're the ones who scheduled the appointment two weeks prior) and instead of asking me if I would like to wait a week to keep her on the schedule that I was prepared to pay for, they gave her the shots and treatments from a previous package (that she already had done at her first vet visit) and then expected me to bring her back in two weeks for those same shots plus the ones she was missing (ostensibly they could not “split up,” the shots; the mobile clinic has done this for me before with no issue); all while paying at least another $220.

I wanted to take her here for the benefit of seeing a vet but I never even got to speak to a vet in person for a wellness check during this visit (which was just about $200 total) I feel like they steam rolled me and then gaslit me into just being okay with it. It left a horrific taste in my mouth and I will not be bringing her back here.
There vetco staff are the best with dogs.
Great experience
Dr. Henderson is great w my Nala! The staff is always so kind.

Waited 40 mins to come out to a rude desk attendant saying it’ll be another 30-45 mins before we are even seen. The doctor is 5 feet from me and trying to whisper she forgot about us and we can leave. Disgustingly unprofessional front desk and the vet couldn’t simply look up and say “oh sorry about the wait” or anything. Zero customer service score if I could.

Dr.Henderson has been Lexie’s Dr. for 10years Lexie actually doesn’t seem nervous anymore going to the clinic. The whole staff is very good and if you don’t mind, I’ll spread the word. Sincerely, Lexie’s Dad, Mark Snyder

My puppy has been here twice. I loved both visits. They explaining everything so clearly and truly make sure you and your pet are comfortable. They help plan next steps and everyone in the entire place is always all smiles and super helpful. Lydia is always so very sweet! My puppy has also had the pleasure for dealing with other team Amazing team members and each handled her with the same love and care as I do. Jason, Kuro, and Alex were the team for today. My puppies last appointments team was Danley, Laura, and Kuro. A defiant 10/10 for the whole crew. This is where you want your pet to be!
Very friendly and professional! My senior pup has gotten the best care and the treats are picky pup approved!

Everyone that works here is great. The techs are caring and gentle with your pet. The Dr is nice, professional and knowledgeable. They give you different alternatives for medication and procedures. They do not pressure you into getting work that is not necessary. I highly recommend.
The vetco team is friendly and detailed! I know my dog is in good hands with this team!
Had a great experience bringing my dog here for the first time. Everyone was so nice, explained things well to me, and treated my dog very kindly.
This Vetco was clean and had very reasonable prices for services! Laura, Lydia, and Dr. Henderson were all very professional and super friendly. They took great care of my dog! Will be returning

Took my dog in today because he has had a limp for the the last 2 weeks and I was so worried it was something serious.  The staff here was amazing and everyone was so kind and patient. Dr. Kim and his assistant Danley took their time examing him and making sure he was calm and comfortable the entire visit. They answered all of my questions and truly made me feel that they cared about my dogs care. Lydia at the front desk was also super sweet and so friendly.  I live a bit of a drive from this office but I will definitely be coming back here for all of my dogs vet needs.  Thank you all so much!
Doctor Henderson  taking excellent  care of my Mia  she doing much bettercI pray she continue  🙏 her progress  and able to heal and run this ☀️  Summer.

I Had a great experience here today Everyone was so kind, supportive, and welcoming. Dr. Kim, Lydia, Danley, and Kuro all took the time to  listen to my concerns and made sure all of my questions were answered. They were very helpful, patient, and caring throughout the entire visit . Thankyou so much for today
Awesome experience all the time.I have taken all of my dogs there over the years.Great personnel and all the doctors.

I was just here yesterday. I made an appointment over the phone and they were very knowledgeable, recognized my concerns regarding my cat and made things work to bring him in asap. The techs were very kind. The vet, Dr. Henderson (if I’m remembering correctly) was very honest, but compassionate about the prognosis of my cat. They didn’t order any unnecessary tests. They referred me somewhere that could provide additional care to my cat. Ultimately, I had to say goodbye to him, but Vetco made the unfortunate and heartbreaking situation much easier for me.
I like this vet  they are really respectful there they helped me with everything I needed for my puppy gave him a dewarm shot now he just sleeping away i highly recommend 🥰
Lydia and the team is always super helpful and accommodating!

I love taking my dog to this vet. We see Dr. Henderson who is always very thorough and friendly to Dobby. Our assistants Kuro and Laura were very nice this time as well. We feel very comfortable here.

I’ve been coming to this clinic for a few years for all of my cats and everyone is always so kind and attentive and my animals love them (as much as a cat who can love a vet can anyway). They always show my cats so much love and make understanding any health concerns and treatment options super easy.
Really lovely and thorough staff. The tech and vet both answered all of my questions and we're super helpful.
Great experience today!! Everyone was so pleasant and knowledgeable.
Excellent staff.  Always runs a few minutes late, but there could be emergencies.
The best vet I ever went to, everybody so nice and helpful.. they explained everything before they did anything and they was kind to my little baby curiosity
Dr. Henderson and her team, along with Lydia (receptionist) were so kind! They answered all our questions and provided such great support for our dog. Highly recommend them!

Love this team so much, always so helpful and advocating toward Aria 🐾  Lydia at the front desk is great always so kind and Dr. Henderson is amazing we always feel welcome and comfortable bringing Aria here

Dr. Jennifer Henderson and her team were incredible!! I have a very anxious cat (Nym) and they made sure he was taken care of all morning. They were kind, patient, and asked all the right questions. We will definitely be back!

The vet and the vet tech were excellent with my fur baby. They talked to her like I do and cupped her little face. Gave her a shot and neither I or her knew she got a shot. Lovely ladies working here.
Staff was very friendly to us and Logan. He was well taken care of while getting his vaccinations.

Had a wonderful experience at Vetco on Clybourn for our cat Barney.  Lydia was super helpful in the booking process and making sure it was a seamless visit.  Dr. Henderson and Laura were wonderful interacting with Barney and explained exactly what was going on in a clear and straightforward manner.  They instantly put me at ease and it was a huge weight off my shoulders.  We will absolutely be back and are thankful to have found their practice!
Everyone is extremely professional and very attentive to my dog. I would highly recommend them to anyone.
Absolutely amazing! The wait wasn't so bad and the whole staff was nice and very knowledgeable. I'm so glad they put my stinky boy in their best ability and care.
Very friendly staff and doctor. Kuro is very nice and appears very knowledgeable.He was able to answer all my question. I will recommend this place to anybody.
Love Dr Henderson and the practice.  Juno wasythe brst patient but she got great care.

Had the best experience visiting VETCO at the Clyborne Chicago location.  I was helped by multiple staff members (Lidija, Kyro)and an excellent veterinarian(Dr. Khalili) that helped to get my senior dog the proper care and all requirements for international travel. They were well experienced and knowledgeable in what we needed and I felt utterly at ease with their team. I highly recommend booking an appointment at this location.

From top to bottom, this is an excellent establishment. The care from the entire staff is top drawer. I could not offer a higher recommendation. My cat, Harry Fisher, was treated like the King he is, and I am very pleased.

My cat and I were taken care of right away. Everyone was very nice and helping me get information from Paws; whom I adopted the cat from for his files. Luckily files were sent and he got a booster shot just in time. I set up the appointment with Petco App. If you pay for premuim membership, exams are free! Loved my experience and Gibson was in great hands. Definitely recommend this Petco location. The place is huge, offers grooming and helps with emergency pet problems. Thank you for an easy appointment and thorough exam today.

Great Experience for my Senior Fur Baby, Scruffy. Dr. Henderson and her staff are the BEST, Technicians Laura and Danely. They are located on Clybourn across from Paws. I love the care administered to him. Not one bark from the little guy--normally, he barks. We were in and out.
First visit, they have a "First Time" Visit Coupon. I saved a lot of money. Better yet, prices are Reasonable, I would come back because Dr. Henderson provides consultation on what to look out for. Breathe a sigh of relief and just call for you and your nonhuman family member(s). I am Happy I called, made appointment and came into Vetco to see what's the matter with Scruffy. You will be happy too.

The staff here were some of the most professional, helpful, empathetic, informative, and accessible I’ve ever met. The whole way through, from scheduling/over the phone consult to the in person appointment, I felt taken care of and more capable of taking care of my lil bean. Thank you guys for taking such good care of Rogue!!
Dr. Henderson and everyone at Petco Clybourn are always nice and sweet to my dog. They try to understand his need make the visit easier.

I’ve been bringing my dog to Vetco Total Care Animal Hospital for years, and I truly couldn’t be happier with the care we receive. Dr. Nelson and her entire staff are always professional, compassionate, and genuinely caring. They take the time to explain everything clearly and make sure I feel comfortable with every decision regarding Stella’s health.

I completely trust them with everything when it comes to her care. Compared to other pet hospitals, their pricing is much more reasonable, and I never feel like I’m being overcharged. I also have the Vital Care Premier membership, which has helped me save money on vet bills and comes with great perks.

I 100% recommend Dr. Nelson and Vetco Total Care Animal Hospital to anyone looking for trustworthy, high-quality veterinary care. Thank you all for taking such amazing care of Stella!

Staff very nice and helpful. It’s my few times taking my pet here at this location and will continue taking my pet here. Lydia the receptionist very nice and friendly and greets when walking in! Very positive and great energy to walk into. <3
Zoe’s doctor visit was great . Her doctor was extremely sweet and gentle Zoe loved them Dr. Henderson is wonderful

I brought in a tiny stray kitten I found，she was only 0.86 lbs and had a huge lump on her neck. The vet was incredibly kind, patient, and took the time to explain everything. Special thanks to Dr.Henderson and laura! They even followed up by text to check on her. Thanks to their care, I’m so grateful for the compassion they showed both me and this little rescue. Highly recommend!
Great service,amazing employees a great place to take your pup!!
Always the best experience...front check in to seeing the vet..everything is explained in detail before leaving...Louie makes new human friends with each visit. Highly recommend this location
Good care. Enjoy how friendly the staff is. Dr. Henderson is great! Affordable with VitalCare, definitely recommend!
The Dr. did not treat my dog 4 her eye at all unfortunately only her wobbling when walks. Did blood work.
I was happy to see my cat go through her examination with low stress at Vetco.The staff was kind, caring, and knowledgeable.
Vetco/Petco N Clybourn was knowledgeable and kind. Our Bernese Mountai Dog's first visit was great. We are sure to return. The prices are the best we've ever had.
I love Petco. The staff is incredibly helpful and provides quick and efficient service. They assisted me with my cat, Saturn.
Entire staff was delightful and they had us in and out within an hour.

My fur babies and I love Vetco! Dr. Henderson is caring, compassionate, and patiently answers all my questions. Jason, the tech, was absolutely wonderful. Lydia was the mvp saving me a small fortune with membership. We’ve had exceptional care at this location.
Quick, friendly, helpful for my cat’s check up. I would recommend

First of all, Petco has come a long way!!!!! I enrolled in their Vital Care program now that they’ve opened Vetco Clinics in Chicago and let me tell you, no regrets. The vets at this location too on are compassionate and detailed. Also, so many vets book weeeeeks out, and while they’re busy, they try to make room. If you have Vital Care, the vet visits are no charge and that’s huge! The prices here are also the best in the city. Dr. Henderson is such a caring and compassionate vet.  We love her!
Dr Henderson, Teans, Lydia and Laura the best and most professional. Such great care they give out four legged family members!
Great vet visit. Easy to schedule, good and caring attention.

I have been coming to this Vetco Total Care location for my 3 year old Schnoodle since I moved to Chicago in July 2025 and I love it. The staff is always so helpful and friendly, and Dr. Henderson is just the best! She always takes her time to explain aspects of my dog’s health to me and makes sure that I feel comfortable with treatment plans for illness/injury by giving me the full picture. The prices are also very reasonable in comparison to some of the other boutique vets I researched in the area. Would highly recommend!

Everyone I met today were super friendly, kind and helpful.  Although my dog is experiencing an allergic reaction, the doctor, technicians and the receptionist were all immediately ready to help care for my dog.  I’m very thankful for their kindness and willingness to help me navigate this issue.
Very clean and friendly staff that understood my needs and was gentle with Lilly ❤️
We had a great experience for our first time here.  Friendly,  kind,  great with my dog and we were in and out very timely.

My visits here have always been met with warm and friendly service. Thank you so much for being able to take in my cat to get seen for her annual diagnostics! I appreciate Dr. Milne, Lydia, Laura, and Danley. Amazing staff and service

Came in today for an annual checkup and was pleased to meet a new doctor who was substituting for Dr. Henderson, whom I really trust with my pet. I was so happy to receive the same level of attention and care.

I was also impressed that the day before, I was politely and kindly asked to reschedule my appointment by 15 minutes to help accommodate an urgent case. With that, my appointment run on ths agreed time and with assistance to the one who really needed it.
It’s great to know that location makes effort to handle emergencies when needed.

The kitties and I are taken directly to exam room when we arrive so they have minimal dog stress.  Prices extremely reasonable with petco rewards program.  Doctors and staff knowledgeable and caring.
Dr Henderson and the vet techs Laura and and  Lydia go above and beyond to help me give my kitties the life they deserve

If I can leave 0 stars I would the manger was a white person and was very racist because I’m a person with brown color. He was supposed to check me in but said I don’t even see you in the schedule when I had made an appointment a week ago and confirmed my appointment 2 days ahead of my appointment and was 10m late because he was busy checking in someone else and spent 8-10 with him. Very rude and disrespectful. Would never come back here and not recommend it to any of my family and friends.
Always timely and friendly. Thank you!

Bad from start to finish.

My appointment was canceled when I didn’t confirm via text. I was given less than an hour to confirm. You read that right. Less than an hour on a workday. I was forced to rebook a less convenient time. Lydia was not helpful at all.

The previous year I requested meds for my very anxious dog and was told to try over the counter hemp medicines. They did nothing. I brought up the issue again this year to find out now any meds would be an additional $200+ because since my dog is now over 10 years old. Why wasn’t this mentioned last year??? It’s constant upselling and pushing for additional services at VETCO. And now I have an extremely anxious dog with no relief.

The vet also wouldn’t give my dog an oral medication because my dog was “giving her the side eye”. My pup is 11 pounds and doesn’t bite. I was given the medicine to administer myself, and it leaked all out of the syringe. Luckily it was in a bag. Went back on a Wednesday to get a replacement dose to be met with an rude technician who was working the clinic. I guess Wednesdays are clinic days and not hospital days. Might want to mention this to your customers.

We’ve had relatively positive experiences at this VETCO in the past, but not this time. I do not recommend.

Dr Henderson was truly a godsend. My cat was diagnosed with FIP the same day I brought him in and she supported us with incredible compassion, care and understanding. She went above and beyond during a very difficult time for us and thanks to her kindness and support, my kitty is now doing much better.

I would also like to thank the techs Lydia and Jason for their kindness and support throughout the process. I am so grateful for this amazing team and highly recommend them.

Everyone was full of help. All my questions were answered. Dr. Managerial reassured me that I could get my 5yr old pet neutered without feeling that he was too old and it would be dangerous. Laura was helpful in helping me to determine the best plan for proheart and flea prevention. Lydia updated me on the details of pro-heart at that location and was kind enough to give me a coupon for free pet food to try out. I left there with more than I came for. Thanks guys.
Lydia is awesome! Helped our dog heartworm test. We arrived 1.5 hours early and she still checked us in, handled the test efficiently!
I had a nice experience. Everyone was friendly and communicative. Laura, Lydia and Dr. Henderson were great to work with, and answered all of my questions.

Dr Henderson is genuinely caring and so good with my kitties. Everyone is good and courteous in this clinic. From the receptionist Lydia and the technicians Jason and Laura, they make you feel welcome. Thank you

The team here always takes loving care of my pup from listening to my concerns, explaining options, and showing him all the love with treats and ear scratches. Dr.Henderson and Technicians Jason and Laura, and Receptionist Lydia are the best!!

Our dogs have been loyal patients of Dr. Henderson’s for 15+ years. She is the best and we’ll follow her anywhere.

Jason and Lydia were extremely helpful and communicative during our visit.

Thanks for making Alfie’s visit so comfortable!
Lydia was great!!! She explained everything the best and made sure I understood. Benito was very happy after his visit.

My granddog had follow up appointment from having an ear infection.  I drove from my house far west to far north to pick him up and  take him to this location ( where his mother takes him). Once we arrived for his schedule appointment, Lindsey told us that his appointment was canceled because they couldn't confirm his net day scheduled appointment. There was no apology from Lindsey but was told we can reschedule for Monday which was a HUGH inconvenience.
